in_sanskrit.name: शान्तु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Shantu is derived from the Sanskrit word शान्त (shānta), which means peaceful, calm, tranquil, soothing, and serene. The name is often used for boys in India and Nepal, and it is believed to bring good fortune and happiness to the child.

in_hindi.name: शान्तू
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Shantu in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit word शान्त (shānta), which means peaceful, calm, tranquil, and serene. The name is often used for boys in India and Nepal, and it is believed to bring good fortune and happiness to the child.

in_tamil.name: ஶாந்து
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Shantu in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit word शान्त (shānta), which means peaceful, calm, tranquil, and serene. The Tamil language uses the script ஶ (ś) to represent the Sanskrit letter श (ś). The name is often used for boys in India and Sri Lanka, and it is believed to bring good fortune and happiness to the child.

in_telugu.name: శాన్టు
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Shantu in Telugu is derived from the Sanskrit word शान्त (shānta), which means peaceful, calm, tranquil, and serene.
